messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- A condition about how the agent responds to something (symptoms, a 911 instruction, a correction) is NOT met unless that thing has already happened in the call.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hi, Kevin Brooks. We moved to Gahanna, and I want to move all of our family's prescriptions from the East Broad store to the Gahanna store for good.
AGENT: Hi Kevin, I'd be happy to help you move your family's prescriptions to Gahanna. Let me look up the stores first and then pull up your prescriptions. I found the Gahanna store. Before I pull up your prescriptions, I need to verify your identity—can you give me your date of birth?  [system actions: find_stores, find_stores]
CALLER: August 30th, 1982. So once you verify that, can we get all three of us switched over today?
AGENT: Great, you're verified. Now I need to know the names and dates of birth for the other two family members so I can pull up all the prescriptions and move them over.  [system actions: verify_identity]
CALLER: Sure, Maya Brooks, born June 20th, 2017. And Eli Brooks, born February 11th, 2010. Can we get all of us switched today?
AGENT (LATEST): Perfect, I've got everyone verified. You have three prescriptions total: your lisinopril, Maya's albuterol inhaler, and Eli's Vyvanse. I can set Gahanna as your home pharmacy for all three of you right away. For your lisinopril and Maya's albuterol, I can transfer those today since they have refills. Eli's Vyvanse is a controlled medication that's already been filled, so that one needs a new prescription from his doctor—I can request that for the Gahanna store. Let me get started.  [system actions: verify_identity, verify_identity, list_prescriptions, list_prescriptions, list_prescriptions]

CONDITIONS:
move_0: the agent says the Vyvanse cannot be transferred
asked_3: In its LATEST turn, the agent asks the caller something that this fact directly answers: "The prescriptions are Kevin's lisinopril, Maya's albuterol inhaler, Eli's Vyvanse"
stop_0: Agent recaps: two moved, defaults set, Vyvanse new-Rx request to Dr. Okafor.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"move_0": {"met": true, "why": "Agent says Vyvanse needs a new prescription instead of transfer."}, "asked_3": {"met": false, "why": "Agent states facts, doesn't ask a question."}, "stop_0": {"met": false, "why": "No recap of completed transfers or doctor name given."}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency services."}}
